## Plain functions

pytest discovers `test_*.py` files and `test_*` functions. Just use `assert` — pytest rewrites it for rich output.

## Fixtures

`@pytest.fixture` provides reusable setup (temp dirs, DB sessions) with teardown via `yield`.

## Parametrize

`@pytest.mark.parametrize` runs a test across many inputs — Python's table-driven testing.
